full_judgment: 6. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid order the defendant-petitioner moved a revisional application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure before this Court and obtained the present Rule. Mr. SG Das, the learned Advocate for the petitioner, contended before this court that the impugned order has been passed by the learned Munsif without assigning any reason whatsoever. He further submits that the petitioner has been contesting the suit diligently from the year 1972 by filing written statement and when the suit reached its at final stage for disposal, the learned Munsif has struck off his name without recording any discussion or finding as to why the petitioner is to be regarded as an unnecessary party to the suit. The order date 15.5.1984 reads as follows “বাদীপক্ষ হাজীরা দেন এবং বাদীর দাখিলকৃত ২৪-৪-৮৪ তারিখের দরখাস্ত শুনানীর জন্য পেশ হয়, প্রার্থনা মঞ্জুর করা গেল, আরজী এবং বালাম বই সংশোধন করা হোক, ৩০-৬-৮৪ তাং সমন জারী অন্তে ফেরত আসার জন্য ধার্য্য থাকে।”
